name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench是一个基于真实世界用户指令的图像编辑评测基准。它旨在提供一个更真实、更全面的评估框架，以衡量图像编辑模型的性能。该基准的发布旨在缩小开源模型与领先的闭源模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）在图像编辑能力上的差距。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
intro_en: GEdit-Bench is an image editing evaluation benchmark based on real-world user instructions. It aims to provide a more realistic and comprehensive framework for assessing the performance of image editing models. The benchmark is released to narrow the gap in image editing capabilities between open-source models and leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.17761. GEdit-Bench is introduced in the Step1X-Edit paper as a real-world image-editing benchmark. The authors collect more than 1K user editing instances from the Internet, including Reddit-style real user instructions, then manually split editing instructions into 11 categories. To preserve diversity, similar-purpose instructions are filtered, producing 606 testing examples with real-world reference images. User-uploaded images are de-identified while preserving the original editing intent and image-instruction fidelity. The evaluation covers open-source and proprietary image editing models. Results use VIEScore with GPT-4o/GPT-4.1-style judging, reporting Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, and Overall Score.
